text: Do not be daunted by the enormity of the world's grief.
Do justly.
Love mercy.
Walk humbly.
Do not strive to enter by the narrow gate.
Just as the trees, if they have not stood before the winter storms, cannot be a fruit.
So it is with us.
This present age is a storm.
And it is only through many trials and temptations that we can obtain an inheritance in the kingdom
of heaven.
It is good to live in peace.
For the wise person practices perpetual prayer.
Stay in your cell and your cell will teach you everything.
There are many who live in the mountains and behave as if they were in the town.
They are wasting their time.
The soul that is attached to anything will not arrive at the liberty of divine union.
It is possible to live in solitude in the desert and yet be filled with the crowd of
one's own thoughts.
And it is possible to live in a crowd and yet be a solitary in one's mind.
The true fast is to refrain from all evil.
The true fast is to keep guard over the eyes, the ears, the tongue and the heart.
The true fast is keeping a pure heart.
If you have a heart, you can be saved.
Neither a setisism nor visuals nor any kind of suffering are able to save.
Only true humility can do that.
I put out my foot to ascend the ladder that is this spiritual path and I place death
before my eyes, before going up it.
In the beginning there are a great many battles and a good deal of suffering for those who
are advancing towards God and afterwards ineffable joy.
It is like those who wish to light a fire.
When we set a light to burn, there is a great deal of smoke and our eyes weep.
But this means we obtain what we seek.
We must kindle the divine fire in ourselves through tears and hard work.
For as it is said, our God is a consuming fire that purifies and transforms.
The true fast is keeping a pure heart.
When you begin to do good, do not think that you have achieved anything.
For you will suffer many afflictions, many other wiles of the devil.
If he is not able to disturb the soul by poverty, he suggests riches.
If he cannot seduce it through pleasures, he tries to overthrow it by sorrows.
If he is not able to disturb it by insults and disgrace, he suggests praise and glory.
The devil is not ignorant of how to fight against us.
But when the soul is at peace, the devil cannot approach it.
The demons themselves said, nothing can overcome us, but only humility.
It is humility which is victorious over the demons.
The greater the sinner, the greater the mercy.
Why do you hate the person who has vexed you?
It is not they who have injured you but the devil.
Hate the disease and not the one who is sick.
If I prayed God that every person should approve of me, I should find myself from all
thought the door of each one.
But I shall rather pray that my heart may be pure toward all.
The one who has fallen has a single thought, that of standing up again.
The soul that is united to God is able to remain calm in the midst of the greatest trouble.
You not be troubled by thoughts that come to you, for they are like clouds passing across the sky.
The more you increase in knowledge, the more you increase in sorrow.
If you are truly seeking the divine, seek it in your heart.
Let your prayer be entirely simple.
Pray without ceasing.
This is a mystery of the age to come.
